place_text: aboard craft near November 5, South Dakota

as_told.title: Small being shows Mario a room of old human objects
as_told.place_text: Aboard craft (items like those of his home in Port Arthur, Texas)

plain: In 1977 in South Dakota, a former guard at a nuclear site named Mario Woods says he was taken aboard a craft and shown a room full of old things, among them a sewing table with a Singer sewing machine on it, in a room with a round window. Woods tells this first-hand and has made drawings of what he saw. In a later telling he adds that a small being led him into the room and let him look, and that the objects looked like the ones in his childhood home in Port Arthur, Texas.
